Yes, the cached data is still available. Your Google connection is not working, though, so I can't pull fresh data.

**Steps, Oct 1–3, 2026 (Google, from local cache):**

| Date | Steps |
|---|---|
| Oct 1 | 1,000 |
| Oct 2 | 2,000 |
| Oct 3 | 3,000 |

The average is 2,000 steps per day, and all three days have data.

**Connection limitation:** Your Google token is invalid and needs re-authorization, so the app shows no verified API connection. Google's consent screen for this app is in Testing mode, and refresh tokens expire after 7 days in that mode. That's the likely cause of the expiry. The summary above comes only from what was already stored locally, so it won't include any changes made since your last sync.

**To reconnect:** Run `ghealth auth login` in your terminal, which refreshes the credentials the app uses. Or I can start a reconnect now through the browser flow, if you'd like. Once reconnected, I can sync to pick up newer data.
